prompt: Keep this photograph exactly as it is: the same old woman, the same face, glasses, cardigan, scarf, the same pose and framing, the same roaring fans behind her and the same light. Change only one thing: the white saucer in her left hand is gone, and in its place her left hand holds a plain dark smartphone, seen from the back, resting low on her lap; its screen is not visible. Her right hand still holds the rose-painted china teacup at chest height. Photoreal documentary frame. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers anywhere.
